evals.name: bank-branch-2050
evals.prompt: We're a design team at a retail bank. Run Dator's four futures exercise for everyday banking in 2050 and place our mobile banking app in each future.
evals.expected_output: Four generic futures (continued growth, collapse, discipline, transformation) for everyday banking, each presented positively with no best/worst/likely labels, an artifact from each future, the exercise questions answered per future, and design decisions robust across all four.

evals.name: university-learning-2045
evals.prompt: A university asks our studio to design its learning experience strategy. Use the four generic futures to explore higher education in 2045 before we propose anything.
evals.expected_output: Four fundamentally different futures of higher education, each experienced from inside, with probability and preferability discussed, five moves toward and five against per future, and a preferred-future sketch.

evals.name: home-energy-app
evals.prompt: We design a home energy management app. Use the four futures method for household energy over the next 30 years and tell us what our product would need to be in each.
evals.expected_output: Four generic futures for household energy, the product placed in each, artifacts from the futures, exercise questions A-E, and a list of design choices that hold across all four; no future labelled most likely.
